sources.note: Scholarship page: tenable in any subject excluding premium rate courses; refers to the Postgraduate Course Directory
Funding Search listing: tenable in any subject excluding premium rate courses; says 114 courses are covered but the list does not open
Funding overview page: describes the Funding Search; gives no per-scholarship course list

subject_rule: Open to any subject: the Trust and the University's Funding Search both say the scholarship is tenable at any Cambridge College in any subject, excluding premium rate courses (the Trust names MBA and MFin as examples).
notes: The Funding Search listing says 114 courses are covered (PhD, full-time or part-time). That figure is the only course-level information that could be read; the names of the 114 courses are not recorded because they could not be opened. The University's postgraduate course directory is the official place where each course is listed.
not_stated: The names of the 114 covered courses.
fetch_problems: The University of Cambridge Funding Search page for this award shows the number of covered courses but the 'See full list' link is an in-page script control: the course names are not in the page text (only two unrelated 'related course' names appear), so the covered-course list could not be read. It was not worked around.
